catch_copy: Escape a city overrun by zombies! Next-generation graphics, breathtaking action, and cooperative survival await. Your adventure starts now!
description:
Dead Stride is a cinematic action game set in a zombie-ravaged city, following two heroes, Kaito and Akane, as they battle their way to a rescue helicopter. Starting with nothing but a baseball bat, you'll uncover hidden weapons across each stage and upgrade your arsenal as you fight to stay alive. With a full opening cinematic and a dramatic ending, Dead Stride delivers a complete and unforgettable story from start to finish.

・Powered by a next-generation engine with stunning visuals for a truly immersive experience!
・Play cooperatively as Kaito and Akane, combine your strengths to clear every stage together!
・Start with just a baseball bat! Discover hidden weapons throughout each stage and upgrade your gear as you progress!
・Collect dozens of varied weapons across the game!
・Fight through diverse locations including city streets, office buildings, underground stations, and narrow corridors!
・Face relentless waves of zombies in pulse-pounding, high-tension gameplay!
・Switch between Kaito and Akane depending on the stage to find the best strategy!
・Experience a fully realised story complete with an opening cinematic and a moving ending!

Step into the story of two heroes, Kaito and Akane. Double the strategy, double the excitement. Fight through a city consumed by the undead and reach the ending that awaits you both!

Prologue
One night, the sky above the city turned black without warning. Strange groans echoed through the streets, and before anyone could react, the infected were everywhere, pouring out from alleyways, buildings, and underground stations. A city that had once been full of life was reduced to ruins in a single night.

Kaito was the star of his athletics club, faster and more agile than anyone around him. Cool on the surface, but burning with determination underneath. When people needed protecting, he never hesitated to put himself on the line. As the outbreak began, he sprinted through the zombie-infested streets, guiding survivors to safety one by one. Without anyone asking, he became their leader.
Akane was a former elite bodyguard, trained by one of the world's top security firms. Skilled in combat, marksmanship, and tactical operations, she had stepped away from the field after an accident years ago. But when the city fell, her instincts snapped back to life. She analysed the situation in seconds, calmed the panicking survivors around her, and began plotting an escape route.

The two crossed paths at a rubble-strewn crossroads in the heart of the city. One look was all it took. They each recognised what the other was capable of. A message arrived on Kaito's phone: Government rescue helicopters are on their way. Head to the old stadium at the north end of the city. You have until dawn. Kaito's speed and Akane's tactics. Their desperate race for survival begins now.
